thread:
mika: Heads-up — putting together a lightweight playbook for adapter compatibility hardening. Focus: LangChain/LlamaIndex connectors, gateway adapters, and orchestration hooks for Dedicated/Private deployments. Looking for input on minimum gating criteria and rollout guardrails.

olivia: Love this. Do we want a single canonical test harness or per-adapter smoke suites?

sam: Prefer canonical harness + adapter-specific shards. Canonical verifies basic LLM roundtrip, auth, and backpressure behavior. Adapter shards test connector-specific features (tooling, indexing).

jon: Agreed. For gating thresholds proposal:
- smoke pass >= 95%
- median p50 latency within 1.5x of native model endpoint for same token length
- memory growth < 2% per minute under sustained 5 RPS

kevin-b: Also add metadata checks before marketplace listing: adapter_version, supported_hw_profiles, quantization_modes (int8/4), required env vars, and enterprise signer info.

mika: Nice list. Can someone sketch the canonical smoke check CLI? we can wire into CI and our onboarding UI.

sam: Quick draft CLI (run locally or in CI):
```bash
redwood-adapter-smoke --adapter-url $ADAPTER --model gpt-open-16k --payload tests/roundtrip.json --timeout 30
```
Outputs JSON: {"latency_ms":..., "success": true, "errors":[]}

olivia: We should capture functional diffs too (tokens changed, hallucination score on eval set). Maybe a small eval set per indexer/connector.

jon: For enterprise SI workflows: require a signed compatibility assertion from partner (PGP or HSM-backed) and a checklist artifact: memory/latency/perf-profile + auth flow diagram. Tegris-bot can verify signature on PR.

tegris-bot: automated-check: signature-verification enabled in org-repo. See https://internal/tegris/docs/signing for details.

kevin-b: Rollout plan idea: canary -> 5% traffic (24h) -> 25% (48h) -> 100% with automatic rollback trigger on error rate > 1.5x baseline OR token-quality regression on eval set > 5%.

mika: Perfect. Owners: sam for harness, olivia for eval sets, jon for signer workflow, kevin-b for marketplace metadata + rollout. I'll draft a short PR with the playbook and a checklist template. :rocket:

olivia: Ping me when PR is up, I'll review the eval set schema.

sam: I'll start the harness repo skeleton and include the CLI + GitHub Action.

jon: I'll stub the signer verification action and link to Tegris docs.

mika: Thanks all — aim to have PR + initial CI checks by EOD Friday. If blockers, drop notes here.

kevin-b: One more ask: include a small compatibility badge for marketplace UI (green/yellow/red) driven by last successful smoke run.

mika: Got it. Adding badge to the checklist.

(ends)
